Description: ISM Manufacturing PMI, a diffusion index of purchasing managers (above 50 = expansion)
Source: Data Master.xlsx (ISM Report On Business), pinned snapshot 2026-10-16
Seasonally adjusted (seasonal factors re-estimated each year)
Known Quirks: No public archive of past values (not on FRED/ALFRED): only today's values exist, so earlier months may differ from first publication (seasonal-factor revisions). Published on the first business day of the following month. Data Master series ends 2025-10
Display Note: A PMI above about 50 marks expanding manufacturing activity.
Used as the equity-market target and benchmark.
